President Donald Trump’s recent approval rating also provides another indication of the current political environment ahead of the 2026 midterms.

Data from the October 23-26 Economist/YouGov poll shows that 39% of registered voters approve of President Trump's job performance and 58% disapprove, a net approval rating of -19 percentage points. Historically, the party of the sitting president has struggled during midterm elections, especially if presidential approval ratings are low.
